builds.name: Reference: Ranked top core
builds.goal: Reference for Jayce: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ top players use most (6,453 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 53.7% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A stance-switching fighter who uses ranged poke to create openings, then commits to melee burst or displacement. The current top provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Youmuu's Ghostblade → Muramana → Voltaic Cyclosword. Stormraider's Surge keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Ionian Boots of Lucidity, Serylda's Grudge, Edge of Night.
builds.summary: The proven top baseline: Youmuu's Ghostblade → Muramana → Voltaic Cyclosword, with Stormraider's Surge.
testPlan: Play it in top as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Youmuu's Ghostblade → Muramana → Voltaic Cyclosword) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 53.7% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Youmuu's Ghostblade → Muramana → Voltaic Cyclosword.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Mercury Hammer - Passive: Jayce's Hammer Attacks grant @spell.JayceStaticField:ManaGain@ Mana.

Mercury Hammer - Active: Jayce creates an electric aura dealing @spell.JayceStaticField:Damage@ magic damage over @spell.JayceStaticField:Duration@ seconds.

Jayce can swap between melee and ranged weapons using Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer starting from level 1. Swapping weapons also swaps all his Abilities and grants him [30] Move Speed for [0.75] seconds.
Hammer Form: Jayce swings his hammer, Knocking Back his target and dealing @spell.JayceThunderingBlow:FlatDamage@ plus @spell.JayceThunderingBlow:PercHPDamage*100@% max Health magic damage.

Mercury Hammer: Jayce transforms his weapon into the Mercury Cannon, gaining Attack Range and new Abilities. Jayce's next Attack removes @spell.JayceStanceHtG:RangedFormShred@ Armor and Magic Resist for @spell.JayceStanceHtG:ShredDuration@ seconds.

Mercury Hammer: Jayce leaps to an enemy, dealing @spell.JayceToTheSkies:Damage@ physical damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by @spell.JayceToTheSkies:Slow*-100@% for @spell.JayceToTheSkies:SlowDuration@ seconds.

builds.name: Hypercharge proc ambush
builds.summary: Use the three maximum-speed cannon attacks for a focused item window.
builds.goal: Use the three maximum-speed cannon attacks for a focused item window.
builds.hypothesis: Hyper Charge grants three attacks at maximum speed with 0.7-1.1 AD damage depending on rank. Blade supplies current-health physical on-hit, Kraken rewards the third attack, and Essence Reaver gives a single post-cast Spellblade plus mana. Transforming into Cannon makes the first attack shred defenses, then Hammer Q/E can finish with mixed damage.
testPlan: Required state: Need high W rank, a clear three-shot target and transformation timing before firing.
Measure each of the three shots and the defense shred before adding Hammer follow-up.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Low-rank W reduces attack damage; target exits range or defensive items absorb the short burst.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Three Hyper Charge attacks do not mean three Spellblade procs without new ready cast windows.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Blade of The Ruined King, Essence Reaver, Kraken Slayer, Infinity Edge, Lord Dominik's Regards, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Physical matchup
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Jayce: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A stance-switching fighter who uses ranged poke to create openings, then commits to melee burst or displacement. Separate ranged gated-Q poke, Hyper Charge attacks and melee commitment. A real Spellblade route must justify form/attack cadence and mana use without double Spellblade items. Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
builds.summary: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Jayce: Separate ranged gated-Q poke, Hyper Charge attacks and melee commitment. A real Spellblade route must justify form/attack cadence and mana use without double Spellblade items.

Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then matchup armor) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Hammer Stance: Leaps to an enemy dealing physical damage and slowing enemies.

Cannon Stance: Fires an orb of electricity that detonates upon hitting an enemy (or reaching the end of its path) dealing physical damage to all enemies hit. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Randuin is conditional on the enemy attack/crit profile; it costs an offensive slot.

The route fails Jayce's stated kit question: Separate ranged gated-Q poke, Hyper Charge attacks and melee commitment. A real Spellblade route must justify form/attack cadence and mana use without double Spellblade items.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Randuin is conditional on the enemy attack/crit profile; it costs an offensive slot.
Full cost 16,100 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Stridebreaker, then matchup armor. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Randuin's Omen, Spirit Visage, Sterak's Gage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.

builds.name: Lightning field hybrid hammer
builds.summary: Test the AP field while retaining useful hammer AD interactions.
builds.goal: Test the AP field while retaining useful hammer AD interactions.
builds.hypothesis: Hammer Lightning Field has 1 AP magic damage over four seconds; Hammer transform adds a magic attack term and Thundering Blow deals percent-health magic plus an AD expression. Gunblade gives mixed offense, Dusk and Dawn rewards a transformation-weaved real attack, and Abyssal serves the field's magic damage. Hammer Q remains physical AD, giving the route an explicit tradeoff.
testPlan: Required state: Need prolonged Hammer contact and reliable form cycling without being kited.
Compare four-second Hammer contact damage against separate ranged poke and standard physical itemization.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Field's small area and weak ranged Q threaten lane control; E knockback ends your own contact.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Hammer E's AD ratio still deals magic; lethality does not improve that component.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
